reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept [IS] GLOBAL in a level-01 data description entry of the File or Working-Storage Section, a file description entry and a report description entry (X.4.6.3 SR1), refuse it elsewhere (another level, a 77 entry, the Linkage Section, which is a 2002 addition), and make the name, its subordinates and condition-names visible to contained programs (GR1, GR2), with only the subject of a REDEFINES entry global (GR3).

edition-consulted.switches: GLOBAL in the Linkage Section is the 2002 construct LinkageGlobal2002; refused (COBOL0900) below 2002, admitted at 2002+
GLOBAL reserved at all four editions

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: GLOBAL on a level-01 Linkage Section entry is refused at 85 and admitted at 2023 (gl2bad at --std 2023 drops the COBOL0900 line)

reader.notes: The three grammar rules print IS? GLOBAL; residence is the one ClausePlacementRules row (level 01, file/working-storage/local-storage/linkage) and the linkage half is gated to 2002 by VersionConformancePass, which is the 1985 SR1's section list.
